0022600205.text: The Wizards (4-6, 9th in the East) come in on a three-game losing streak, and they're 2-4 on the road, while the Pistons (6-3, 1st in the Central) are on a two-game skid after a 6-3 stretch. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, and Anthony Davis and Bilal Coulibaly are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe and Jalen Duren. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
